TAL_WEAPONS_ARMAMENT_CONDUIT_INITIATE.why: Explicit owned proficient Conduit Weapon choice; no stat replacement by this talent.

TAL_WEAPONS_CASTING_HAND_WEAPON_METHOD.why: Owned Conduit Weapon attack variants replace the ability while retaining weapon costs and requirements.

insight.careful-grip-disciple.why: Advantage against a disarm of the selected held conduit; chosen-profile protection remains manual.

insight.conduit-hand-correction.why: A near miss by one or two with the selected held conduit optionally waives miss damage and protects the next qualifying saving throw.

tianxia.talent.weapons.long_weapon_measu.why: One Reaction per round to a perceived enemy entering the actual held Reach weapon profile, through each willing movement step.
